physical_side_convention: Vehicle left/right as seated looking forward. Right profile faces image-right; left profile faces image-left.
notes: Silver-chrome board on vehicle-right; orange-chrome board on vehicle-left. Catalog photos and HW Collectors News casting description agree; HWRLC prose calls the latter red. Photographed color governs.
inferred_details: Precise orthographic reprojection is synthesized from oblique photographs.
